title: Child and Youth
intro: Programs and services for military families and their children.

sections.heading: Child Development Centers
sections.markdown: We foster physical, cognitive, social, and emotional development in a safe and nurturing environment.

sections.heading: Exceptional Family Member Program
sections.markdown: Support for military families with special medical and/or educational needs.

sections.heading: Family Child Care
sections.markdown: We provide your child, aged 6 weeks to 12 years, with a nurturing environment, that supports their development.

sections.heading: New Parent Support
sections.markdown: The New Parent Support Program (NPSP) is a professional team of social workers, counselors, and resource specialists.

sections.heading: School Liaison
sections.markdown: To promote awareness of the unique educational needs of military-connected children and facilitate support.

sections.heading: School Age Care
sections.markdown: We offer a safe, engaging environment for children ages 5-12, providing homework assistance, recreational activities.

sections.heading: Youth & Teen Program
sections.markdown: Youth & Teen Centers provide a variety of recreational activities for teens ages 13-18yrs enrolled in the program.
